note: Coverage exemptions for the Channel 0.2 verification gates. `build/verify-channel-0.2-coverage.ps1` runs each gate under a line trace and requires every conditional in it to be evaluated by a passing run; a gate marked `measureOperands` is additionally run from an instrumented copy that records each operand of every `-and`/`-or` expression, and every operand whose expression was evaluated must have been evaluated too. An entry in `exemptions` declares one construct a passing run correctly cannot reach, and an entry in `operandExemptions` declares one operand short-circuiting correctly never reaches, each with the reason. Three classes are exempt structurally rather than by entry, in the gate itself: anything inside a `catch`, the `foreach ($failure in $failures)` loop each gate prints its findings with, and an operand whose whole expression was never evaluated -- that last one is the condition measure's subject, and reporting it here would report the facts gate's `-Apply` path a second time under another name. Those are expressed as a walk to the root, as the collection the loop walks, and as the expression's own evaluation, not as lists of the ones that exist today, because AN2 was a list that held eight of nine. `coverWhenNested: false` marks a gate a nested run does not cover, which is how the two recursion cycles are broken: this gate covers itself, and it covers the harness one of whose probes runs it.

authority.note: An exemption is a claim that a construct or operand cannot be reached by a passing run. It is not a way to quiet the measure: an entry whose construct is reached fails, and an entry whose construct no longer occurs fails as stale, on the same rule the probe corpus applies to a rotted anchor. A check that is unreachable because no input exercises it is a missing input and belongs in the vector corpus, not here -- which is AR1, and is why this file has no entry for the two property clauses that had no input, nor for the four AT1-AT3 operands the operand measure found the same way.

exemptions.reason: AK3's `N capabilities owe` claim. Every capability cell in the per-capability property audit is filled against an executable evaluator, so no capability owes a required-green set and no artifact makes the claim. The guard is dormant because the residual work it counts is finished, which is not the same as expired: it fires again the moment the claim reappears. The AQ pass read this one and reached the same conclusion.
The body of the dormant AK3 claim loop above. Unreachable for the same reason and for exactly as long.

operandExemptions.reason: The closed-vocabulary check on the closure-cycle state. The cycle is on hold, so the first operand is false on every clean run and short-circuiting never reaches this one. It is reached by the probe that declares a state outside the vocabulary, which is the input this operand exists for; it is exempt from the clean-run measure rather than unexercised.

The same closed-vocabulary shape on the operand-enumeration verdict column. Every row in the clean package records `sufficient`, so the first operand is false on every row and this one is never reached. AT5 added the probe that declares a verdict outside the vocabulary; as with the hold state, the operand is exempt from the clean-run measure and not from the corpus.

exemptions.reason: Inside the branch that reports a property whose verdict is not the declared one. A passing run has no such property, so the message this line decorates is never built.
The same, for an operand mutation whose verdict is not the declared one.

operandExemptions.reason: The second of the two artifacts a named mutation may be stated in. Every declared mutation is named by the completeness review's per-capability audit, so the first operand is false for all of them and the contract is never consulted. The operand is a deliberate second source rather than a missing input: the contract names C4's two scenarios, and a mutation moved out of the audit into the contract alone must not become a failure. It is reached only by an input that has one and not the other, which no conforming package has.
